buildifier configuration. buildifier is in both devShells in flake.nix and NOT yet wired
into presubmit.yml — see the 'NO BUILDIFIER STEP' note in .github/workflows/presubmit.yml
for why: `buildifier --mode=check -r .` currently reports 549 files, all of them the same
cosmetic disagreement about how a multi-argument glob() wraps, and a gate that is red on
the day it lands gets switched off rather than fixed.
This file is what that step will read when the formatting sweep lands in its own commit.
Having it here first means the sweep is `buildifier -r .` and a baseline change, rather
than a sweep plus an argument about settings.
warningsList is the lint set, and it is narrower than buildifier's default `all`. Every
warning listed is one that catches a real defect in Starlark rather than a style opinion;
the ones left out are either already enforced elsewhere in this repository or produce
findings nobody acts on. Widen it in a commit that also fixes what it newly reports.
